title: Strict ordinary Tate quotient tower data
statement: For a Noetherian scheme T, a prime ell invertible on T, and d natural, there exist an AdicTower M for datum ell, isomorphisms from M.level n to the single complex in degree -2d of quotientLine T ell n d, and an equality M.tower = strictDerivedTower T ell d.

proof.text: Use the quotient-linear pre-tower construction, then supply its cocycle coherence and package the fields as an AdicTower. The pre-tower level comparisons and strict tower equality are unchanged.
